hook.note: Volume 3 is the volume everyone knows in RED. What no red-letter Bible has ever shown you is the other voice in it: our Father speaks only 2,009 words in the whole New Testament, and this is one of the moments. In BLUE, at 14 point, you can find them — and the Spirit's 95 words in PURPLE besides.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.

Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Across the whole Bible our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies.

This is Volume 3 of the three-volume Large Print edition: the New Testament, Matthew through Revelation, 27 books in full text — 260 chapters and 7,942 verses, not abridged. In this volume the Son speaks 35,494 words in RED, our Father 2,009 words in BLUE, and the Spirit 95 words in PURPLE. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

Set in 14-point type in a single column across the page, so every line reads whole and poetry keeps its shape. Most Bibles labelled large print are 10 to 12 point, and the ones that go bigger force the whole Bible into a single volume on thin paper — ghosting the text through from the other side, and too heavy to hold open. Three volumes on opaque 50lb white paper answer both.

And the large print does more than enlarge the words: Divine Voice Color shows you who is speaking, so it serves your ear as well as your eye. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 342 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. The full opening pages — Abba Father, a message from Kevin and Shelly, Receiving Your Father, the Preface and About this Translation — are in every volume. A presentation page carries their name.
At 680 pages this is the shortest of the three volumes, and the one most often carried to church.
He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek. The three volumes together carry the complete Bible — 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: Why This Large Print Bible Reads Easier — And Lets You Hear Him
body: Most Bibles labelled large print are 10 to 12 point, and the bigger ones force the whole Bible into one volume on thin paper — text ghosting through from the other side, and too heavy to hold open. This is true 14 point on opaque 50lb white paper, split into three volumes you can hold.
And it does more than enlarge the words: Divine Voice Color shows you who is speaking, so the large print serves your ear as well as your eye — you can see, and hear, your Father speaking.
God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6).

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.a: The whole New Testament — Matthew, Mark, Luke, John, Acts, the letters from Romans to Jude, and Revelation. 27 books in full text, 260 chapters, 7,942 verses. Nothing is abridged, summarized or left out.

faq.q: Do I need all three volumes?
faq.a: Only if you want the whole Bible. Volume 1 is Genesis–Esther in Wheat, Volume 2 is Job–Malachi in Sage, and Volume 3 is the New Testament in Mist Blue. Each stands on its own and each carries the full opening pages. Volume 3 is the natural first volume for a new reader, and the one most often given as a gift.

faq.q: Is this just a red-letter New Testament in bigger type?
faq.a: No. The Son's words are in RED, as you would expect — 35,494 of them. But our Father also speaks in the New Testament, 2,009 words of it, and the Spirit 95, and no other Bible shows you where. In this volume you can see all three voices, at 14 point.

Both are offered, 6 x 9, in the Mist Blue cover. Paperback (ISBN 979-8-89307-341-6) if you are going to carry it and mark it; hardback (ISBN 979-8-89307-344-7) if it is a gift or it is going on a shelf for years. The interior is identical — 680 pages, full color throughout.

faq.q: Why is this volume cheaper than the other two?
faq.a: Because it is about half the size. The New Testament runs 680 pages at 14 point, where Volume 1 runs 1,134 and Volume 2 runs 1,142. The price follows the page count, not the importance.
